captions.caption: This news segment reports on a serious train collision with a car in Douglasville, Georgia. The broadcast opens with a "NEW DETAILS" graphic, then transitions to aerial footage showing the aftermath: a red car is wrecked on the tracks next to a freight train, with police and emergency crews on the scene. A CBS Atlanta news reporter delivers a live on-site report at night from the scene of a train collision with a car in Douglasville, Georgia. He stands on the roadside, gesturing toward the intersection of E Broad St and Mozley St, where the incident occurred, as indicated by the map graphic displayed on screen. The report provides new details about the accident.

A live news report from Douglasville, Georgia, at night, shows a reporter gesturing toward the scene of a train collision. The footage transitions to an aerial view revealing a train stopped at a railroad crossing, with emergency personnel and a damaged vehicle at the site. The segment then shifts to ground-level shots of responders examining the train car, indicating an active investigation into the incident.

A news report details a train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing in Douglasville. The segment opens with workers at the scene, then cuts to a local resident, Robert Woods, who points to the location of the accident. The main event is shown through aerial footage, revealing the wreckage of the red car pinned between the train and the tracks, with a man standing on the train's caboose.

A news report captures the aftermath of a train collision with a red car at a railroad crossing in Atlanta. The first frame shows the damaged vehicle crushed by the train, while subsequent frames show the crossing in use by other vehicles and feature an on-site interview with a witness, highlighting the incident at this specific intersection.

A news reporter stands at a railroad crossing in Atlanta, where a white sedan has just collided with a train, causing significant damage to the road surface near the tracks. The scene shows traffic navigating the intersection, with a white pickup truck passing by, while the camera zooms in on the broken asphalt and debris at the point of impact, highlighting the aftermath of the accident.
A news report from Atlanta documents a train collision with a red car on railroad tracks at an intersection, showing the wreckage, emergency response, and an on-site reporter speaking to the camera.

A news report covers a serious traffic accident where a red car has collided with train tracks, with a tow truck and emergency personnel on scene. The segment transitions to a live on-site report by CBS Atlanta reporter Steve Kiggins, who provides new details about the incident at night.
